meta.title: Work Components
meta.description: Mounts and manages MCP servers that drive other work apps (Office, Blender, Unity, Figma, Photoshop, Chrome, Godot, Windows, Desktop, Notion, Gmail, Cloudflare, GitHub, ComfyUI, FFmpeg, Obsidian) from one settings page, plus per-game GameBot cards (Minecraft, Civilization VI, vision fallback), session controls, the mm_send_image tool, and chess plus card games (blackjack, Leduc, limit hold'em, UNO, and doudizhu; rules downloaded on demand).
